title: Strange child behaviour
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: Godot v4.6.2.stable.arch_linux [001aa128b]
Reproducible in: Godot v4.5.2.stable.custom_build [6ce3de25a]
Reproducible in: Godot v4.7.dev.custom_build [a8643700c]

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable (001aa128b) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 21 Apr 2026 23:38:22 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (nvidia; 595.58.03) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700 CPU @ 3.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.56 GiB memory

### Issue description

Came across this strange bug when following a project tutorial when creating an ammo pickup interaction and it's effect on an ammo counter and label. Managed to to recreate in a minimal implementation linked below.

It has 3 scripts shape.gd, shape_switch.gd, shape_handler.gd.

2 shapes that inherit from a shape scene and _shape.gd, and are children of a ShapeSwitch scene. spacebar to give tribute to each shape.

shape_switch.gd handles displaying and switching between shapes with 1 and 2 keys to switch between a cube and ball shape.

shape_handler.gd stores the tributes given to each shape, and updates the label for each shape accordingly.

However, when pressing the spacebar when the cube is displayed, the label doesn't update, but it updates as expected when the ball is displayed. And if i reorder the children, the label doesn't update when the ball shape is displayed, but updates as expected when the cube is displayed.

### Steps to reproduce

Switch the order of children in the ShapeSwitch scene, and run the project.
Press the spacebar to add exclamation marks to the dictionary of tributes for each shape.
1 and 2 keys to switch between shapes.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[child-boolean-flag.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27081412/child-boolean-flag.zip)
